notes.title: March 11, 2018 Update
notes.notes:
Hey Champions! No pictures today, just patch notes. Fixed up a few issues and made a few changes. Still working hard on completing the SS Rank and more content. It's a pain to keep going sometimes.

This update fixes a really annoying bug though, where completing the C Rank wouldn't actually allow you access into the B Rank shops. Go into the Arena area if you've completed the C Rank to fix the issue.

ADDITIONS:
✪ Added a current level for Hires when you go to hire them so you can remember what level they are
✪ For Leora's Explosive Arrow, an animation will play on all other targets when the explosion successfully happens
✪ Denira's Shine Blast, an animation will play on all other targets when the explosion successfully happens


CHANGES:
✪ Tail Whip's lower defense status has been changed to 3 turns from 5 turns.
✪ Save Prompt saves to the 11th save slot, which is an autosave slot
✪ Lowered Magic Attack of Staves, Staff Blades, Clubs, Maces, Flails
✪ You can no longer stack accessories of the same type that are the same rank together
✪ Removed Magic Damage Boost from Mage's Playbook
✪ Lowered power of the Skill Dark Grasp
✪ Enemies of Darkness who use a Healing skill no longer Drain HP and instead heal HP as intended

FIXES:
✪ Fixed a bug where completing the C Rank would not complete the C Rank
✪ Fixed position of Battle Recoveries menu element inside the Arena
✪ Fixed SS Rank Armor Shop items
✪ Fixed the Weapon Shop and Armor Shop faces when you talk to them to buy from them.
✪ Fixed Derack's Basic Sword attack -- again.
✪ Fixed Felia's Ballistic Blast causing a crash on Skill Unleash!
✪ Removed all of Felia's Trident skills from players to fix a bug where they wouldn't be removed upon skill learn.
✪ You can now use keyboard input to select a champion in Skill / Level shops if you have selected them as your main character
✪ Numerous Enemy skills now have elements
✪ You can enter the SS Rank Orb Shop now.
✪ You will no longer be able to encounter 8 Pumpkins in the random A Rank fights.
✪ Denira's Kurien's Embrace uses the correct cast animation now.
✪ Minor Skill Fixes
✪ Minor Text Fixes

notes.title: Febuary 20th Update
notes.notes:
Hey Challengers, welcome back to Mythic Victory Arena! It's Resi here with another intriguing update to keep your interests in the Arena at peak performance. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/9a13acc675eeef09cc451f74f7ca5c06e7b5a4f9.png

What's all that Press 1 and Press 2? Amazing, is what they are. Read about it below.

Menus Redone
I was constantly aware of the bog that the menus were previously, being text on a screen that was not appealing. They were placeholders until I got enough in my budget to cough up said budget and put it into some actual effort. These handcrafted icons created by Rexard (Go support their creations here - https://www.gamedevmarket.net/member/Rexard/ ) fit well into Mythic Victory Arena and should really make it easier for you to navigate the menus.

But that's not all! Take a look and see for yourself.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/5fa3093fca6ba9422f7e2dc90b4420e1af614f05.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/ebfe29ad911a9f612dda4870ddff18a2feb5f580.png

Woah! That's a lot of information. What does it all mean? It means you can now play Mythic Victory Arena solely with a keyboard. The mouse-only design isn't very efficient for some players and I found this to be the most effective solution. Each Icon has accompanying text with a specific character colored in Green. If you press the corresponding key on your keyboard to that of the Green colored character, you'll be able to access the menu of that Green character. Try it out when you get back in the game!

More Weapons!
As you continue to grow and progress through the arena, you'll start taking more names and gaining more EXP than you know. You'll hit level 20 and beyond without much thought towards it. What about more weapons for reaching these milestones? To kick it off, Leora, Derack, and Denira all gain new weapons once they hit Level 20 and beyond. Leora gets a second one too at level 25.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/9fc7c3507757b2d15100420d1f8d2433371f4c75.png

A Katana for Derack. A Shotgun and Rifle for Leora. A Flail for Denira. These weapons each come with 4 new learnable skills which you can purchase from the Skills Shop.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/f4a139e4002a52d043cee2bb29c0e6e23f3ca936.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/c826eaea5ee1b22a09014570ffaa6620c7ba8eed.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/313df2a9b5cce3065b816137192d44ee8229e34a.png

Unlocking these weapons in game will also unlock the corresponding achievement, for all you achievement hunters out there.

Statuses!
Many Status have been given their own animations that play once a battler has been inflicted with that status. You'll see it the most with the Death and the Guard status. The more common ones you'll notice are Bleeding, Wet, Stun, and Burned. It should help make the Arena feel more visceral.

Patch Notes!
That's all for now. The rest of the patch notes should clue you in on the progress that's been made towards making Mythic Victory Arena feel like the game it was always going to be.

ADDITIONS:
✪ Added S+ Rank Encounters
✪ Added SS Rank Orbs and Glyphs
✪ Added a Synch FPS Option for low-end PCs. You can disable it from the options menu (You really shouldn't).
✪ Added Blunderbuss for Leora to unlock at level 20
✪ Added Rifle for Leora to unlock at level 25
✪ Added Katana for Derack to unloack at level 20
✪ Added Flail for Denira to unlock at level 20
✪ New Interface design to give a more polished feeling
✪ Animations play on a user inflicted with specific Status conditions
✪ Unlockable Weapons now have Skill Unleash sequences
✪ Added New Achievements for the new unlockable weapons

CHANGES:
✪ You can no longer purchase older rank versions of skills
✪ Consecutive CQC no longer requires all other skills of its rank to be unlocked for it to be purchased
✪ Drastically reduced cost of Hospital Heal cost
✪ Level up rewards are now based on your current rank, and not the rank of the arena you are in
✪ Gold Level up reward formula has been changed to be more beneficial
✪ Experience level up reward formula has been changed to be more beneficial

FIXES:
✪ Fixed SS Rank Shop
✪ Fixed EXP values of Dark Star and Dark Angel
✪ Fixed an issue with Orb Rewards
✪ Fixed a bug with Derack's and Molly's F Rank Fire Skill
✪ Fixed a bug with Denira's Club skills
✪ Fixed Denira's Spiritual Touch not working as intended
✪ Fixed Denira's Shine Blast not working
✪ Fixed Leora's Coin Bolt from not working as intended. It shows if you pick up AC
✪ Fixed Pain Swap missing an animation
✪ Fixed many default attacks and prevented them from Skill Unleashing by default
✪ Fixed Bronze and Iron Staves using the wrong Attack
✪ Minor Item Fixes
✪ Minor Text Fixes

notes.title: January 29th Update
notes.notes:
After a stagnant month (or two, don't shame me) in hiatus, I return with hard work and many more adjustments! Keep up the good fight, Challengers!

Hospital UNLEASHED
The older iteration of the Hospital didn't have much thought into how it worked and how well it worked out. This is a step to improve previous design and moving forward it will be adjusted to a finer setting. For now, it it as shown.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/a0be8eccad8dbfacac526de1b1212c8da754af65.png

You can receive instant heals for a set amount of your Arena Coins based on the Rank you currently are.
You can also purchase up to 10 Battle Recoveries which instantly fully recover you after a battle. If you have the Pro Mode option disabled, you will be able to have control over when you decide to Recover.

Battle Recoveries appear on the screen so you know how many you have left.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/7c81826cfc501d5ba7f67de7ef1fae7cd57dee5f.png

S Rank UNLOCKED
Probably the most brutal Rank released yet, the S Rank will teach you just how broken Mythic Victory Arena is. Be sure you grinded wins in the other ranks and received some of the best Set Items you can find to get a real upper hand in this rank. 50 Battles of unending pain and suffering.

Also, one new addition to battles is that each character currently in battle will have their level shown in their respective HUD.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/6083ae87f204cb472cae05e02b071a29198a102a.png


Leora Art UPDATED
Miabun has released an updated version of Leora from her old works. Check it out!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/761fe20f42bc93c4c88d2fe8538070a836f21d34.png

Other Additions
Potions and Elixirs now have Skill Unleash modifiers, which double the amount of HP you can receive from a Potion if you get a Skill Unleash! (Yes, I know Items aren't skills, fight me.)
The value Potions and Elixirs damage creatures of Darkness has been lowered and in the future will have their own unique formulas instead of set damage.

Take a look at the rest of the notes below. Tons of changes and fixes for quality of life when it comes to playing Mythic Victory Arena.

Patch Notes!
ADDITIONS:
✪ New Hospital. Full Recovery for a percentage of your AC.
✪ Purchase 10 Auto Recovers for after battle.
✪ Potions and Elixirs have Skill Unleash attributes now, doubling their healing power
✪ Current Level is shown in battle now
✪ New Leora Art

CHANGES:
✪ Due to an issue with Refined Orbs and Glyphs not functioning as intended, all Refined Augments have been removed and replaced with Compensation Vouchers, which you may sell for the price you purchased the augment for.
✪ Lowered AC cost of unlocking skills by 50%
✪ Insight Orb now grants TP Regeration instead of TP Charge (which probably did nothing)
✪ Phase Glyph now grants Magic Evasion instead of lowered Target Rate (Which did not work!)
✪ Lowered damage formula of Crossbow and Bow
✪ Lowered overall Experience Curve of each character
✪ Lowered overall Agility Growth of each character
✪ Lowered Drel's base Magic Attack
✪ Lowered power of Molly's Vibrant Spark
✪ Lowered overall TP cost of Leora's skills
✪ Lowered overall TP cost of Ralph's skills
✪ Dread Cloak is now bodygear
✪ Mage's Playbook now has Silence resistance instead of Holy resistance
✪ Lowered Magical Attack of Staves
✪ Lowered Magical Attack of Drel's and Molly's Grimoires
✪ Lowered Defense Bonus of Plate Armor
✪ Leora's Skills now have element typing, meaning they do extra damage to enemies weak to ranged attacks
✪ Leora's Camouflage grants Increased Evasion Rate for 3 turns instead of Decreased Target Rate
✪ Derack's Roar hits 2 times now instead of 5 times.
✪ Critical hit formula is changed to make them less rare
✪ Lowered HP of many B Rank enemies
✪ Fear status lowered to 3 turns from 5 turns

FIXES:
✪ Gambler's Debt reward for clearing a rank works now
✪ Gambler's Debt no longer shows a false Clear Bonus
✪ Guard actually works as intended now
✪ Leora may no longer learn Precision Bolt if you don't have the Crossbow unlocked
✪ Leora's arrow skills no longer hit too many times at full power
✪ Leora's Explosive Arrow no longer explodes if it misses (I HOPE!)
✪ Leora's Dark Arrow cost has been fixed
✪ Leora's Grapping Bolt's damage formula has been fixed
✪ If an enemy dies from Leora's Explosive Arrow or Denira's Shine Blast, the enemy will properly be removed from the battle.
✪ Ralph's basic attack unleash has been fixed
✪ Ralph's Rundown heals whole number values now
✪ Ralph's Rundown no longer always heals
✪ Ralph's Bloodbath doesn't lock up the game looking for an image that doesn't exist
✪ Enemy's Grapple no longer stuns 100% of the time
✪ Bunny and Wolf enemies now call their backup correctly
✪ You can get the D Rank Reward at 100 wins now
✪ Forest Slime+ now appears in the D+ Arena Battles
✪ Thorn Armor Glyph is now a glyph and not an orb
✪ A+ Battles work now

notes.title: November 29th, 2017 Update
notes.notes:
Welcome back to the fight, challengers! Today's update brings in new and interesting additions and some changes that were desperately needed to keep Mythic Victory Arena fresh and unique.

New DLC! Unlock All Skills
Launching alongside this update is a new DLC, which when you purchase it, unlocks all skills for each character that they can normally unlock through leveling up. This grants you more opportunity to gain EXP or Arena Coin when you level up. In the future, I'll add extra Level Up Rewards to make up for the current lack of options.

You may purchase the new DLC below.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/748030/Mythic_Victory_Arena__Unlock_All_Skills/

Action Enhancer Buff!
The Action Enhancer item now has a little extra detail; it increases your Skill Unleash chance. It shows a percentage based chance, but the math is as follows. By default, you have a 1 in 16 chance to activate Skill Unleash! When you stimulate yourself with an Action Enhancer, the chance to activate Skill Unleash! becomes 1 in 5. Take advantage of this when it comes to what you're about to read next.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/38354ff8d6a384627e166374f31a334e85173f5e.png


Basic Attack UNLEASHED
All basic attacks that each character can perform now have Skill Unleash! sequences unique to each weapon. As development continues, a more up-to-date trailer will be posted to the Steam Store and announced for you to fawn over. Take advantage of using Action Enhancers to have better odds at the Skill Unleash!

Who's Next?
As it stood before, during your first time play through, you likely weren't sure of what enemy you were about to face. And while it may not be helpful during a first time play through, it's good information to have regardless. Before you enter into an Arena Fight, you will be shown which enemy you are going up against. This way, you don't have to worry about what enemy is gonna be giving you a hard time as you enter.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/8edfbdb6811b745ed0fb27e50dd66c2c55bebb34.png

Updated Damage Information

This update is so massive in fact, I highly recommend you start up a new file. Not like that matters though, as there was a bug that prevented you from progressing past the F Rank. That's been fixed, by the way.

Skills, Enemies, and More!!

✪ New Ralph art!

  ✪ Force of Will now hits 3 times
  ✪ Meteor Strike's damage has been lowered and now hits multiple times

  ✪ Barrage now hits all enemies multiple times and is a Ranged element
  ✪ Dash can now target allies

  ✪ Grappling Bolt now hits multiple times
  ✪ Slow Bolt chance to inflict sluggish has been replaced with a chance to inflict slow
  ✪ Patience Shift can now target allies
✪ Changes to Derack's Skills:
  ✪ Slice n' Dice is no longer a Certain Hit skill
  ✪ Bide Power state lasts only 2 turns now instead of 3
  ✪ Parley has 90% accuracy now
  ✪ Saber Slash's damage has been lowered

  ✪ Sweep now hits twice
  ✪ Breathe Fire is now a Magical Attack and hits multiple times
  ✪ Shared Pain is now a Magical Attack
  ✪ True Strength can now target any enemy, but does more damage to enemies with 150 or more Attack
✪ Changes to Borrel's Skills:
  ✪ Flurry of Punches now hits multiple times  
  ✪ Meditate's cooldown is now 5 turns
  ✪ Consecutive CQC is now a Physiscal Attack and can crit. It also hits multiple times
  ✪ Revitalize now heals Borrel alongside its revive effect, however it may still only be used if there is a dead ally to target
  ✪ Blackout now hits multiple times and no longer has a chance to inflict blindness. Instead, if Borrel is blind, the skill deals more damage
  ✪ Rest has been renamed to Deep Meditation
  ✪ Disable now hits multiple times
  ✪ Fists of Life now hits multiple times
  ✪ Puncture's infliction status has been lowered
  ✪ Bloodletting is now 70% accurate
✪ Changes to Molly's Skills:
  ✪ Revolt is now 85% accurate
  ✪ Sparks now hits multiple times and can only inflict Shocked now
  ✪ Blade Rush now hits multiple times
  ✪ Bleed Dry is now 90% accurate
✪ Changes to Denira's Skills:

  ✪ Pray is much more random and much more volatile now. Have fun!

  ✪ Ice Bash can now critical hit. It also hits twice
  ✪ Thunder Bash can now critical hit. It also hits twice
  ✪ Wind Bash can now critical hit. It also hits twice

  ✪ Shine Blast no longer has a chance to stun. The explosion has its own damage formula now
  ✪ Spiritual Touch can target actors or enemies and its chance to inflict smiting sickness has been lowered.
  ✪ Wrath of Kurien now hits everyone and will instantly kill anyone who has the smiting sickness status inflicted upon them.
  ✪ Pommel Bash is now a Physical Attack
  ✪ Skull Crack now has a chance to inflict Dazed
✪ Changes to All-Class Skills

  ✪ Shield skills are usable as long as you have any shield equipped
  ✪ Stack Hit targets down a single enemy now
  ✪ Book of the Dead's Reflection now lasts for 3 turns instead of 5
  ✪ Book of the Dead skills are useable as long as you have any book of the dead equipped
  ✪ Mirror move can now target enemies or allies
✪ Changes to Enemies Skills

  ✪ Consentless Attack has been renamed to Consentacles

  ✪ Fiery Bite only has a chance to Burn now
  ✪ Deadly Gaze has had its accuracy lowered and is more balanced.

FIXES:

notes.title: Status of Next Update
notes.notes:
Hey challengers, champions, and even the spectators in the crowd! It's Resi and I feel like I should talk about the progress of the next update. 
It really looks like I was working non-stop on the project and pushing out an update every week or so because I had plenty of content to bring forth and now it seems like it has declined, as it has been almost 2 months without an update. There is a good reason for that, and I'll tease everything here, as it still isn't finished and won't be for another month or 2 again.

Skills Revamped
Inspired by another creator, I decided to revamp how skills functioned and give them the depth they so badly required to make Mythic Victory Arena more interesting. I won't explain how everything works just yet (wait for the update!) but here is a video of it in action.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QkiysH8_nCw&feature=youtu.be
You can see there are a lot of kinks to work out. Also, see that weird sequence on Rundown? That has a 6% chance of happening. Almost every skill has these rare 6% sequences.

Skills will look more interesting in the upcoming update. They will also read more legibly to the average player. Here's what I mean:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/c8590c34288e1c8d42a5f77fc962540936187acb.png

Battle Hud
If you watched the youtube video, you can see something nice. The battle hud has been updated. The turn order window is vertical and the battler information doesn't take up a majority of the screen, allowing for you to see more things happening in battle.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/13b94c6ddbc10cecefc3d02c80bd73b9e2369509.png

Re-described
Every item in the game has been given new descriptions to give them polish and to make it easier for players to know what their items, skills, armors, weapons are doing.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/258d5e3e872f5f2c8b74f5e09bcdd7bb3ab4217e.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/fda2a4d05c0031af14ec7d5a3df66650d5715044.png

Updated Art
The artist, Miabun, has been hard at work updating her older character art creations into characters that fit her new style, which she has shown through Molly and Felia. Once all the characters are updated, Steam Trading Cards will be added.There are still four more to complete.
Here's Ralph and Denira! 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/9f1f7a3a0720530181e7232ca3ded3abf72fdfb8.pnghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/bda9b4d840ee1be924de0f861bdad08c3f6dbd27.png


New Menus
Thanks to the input of fungho, who really opened my mind in how I present the game, the upcoming update will feature an upgraded menu scheme. You will be seeing less square menus in the middle of the screen and will instead be greeted with an overworld and more. It's still a work in progress, but here's how it looks so far.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/40ae1ca3dda35801bf9eaadd247da0f03f860033.pnghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/985bb4ee5de1d733cf40b8ffd985ffe8297f1273.png

Anyway, that should be it for now. I should get back to working hard on the huge list of tasks I have so you can experience these changes for yourself!

notes.title: July 17th Update
notes.notes:
Challengers and Champions, I am glad to present to you a wonderful update to Mythic Victory Arena!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/b69c227033ee2efd1ba47be60541c9e3a304dab2.png
Molly!
The art for Molly the Battlemage has been completed by Miabun. This teenage witch will blow your socks off with her powerful witchcraft and magic. Also, she uses swords!

A Rank Unlocked! New Enemy Art
The A rank has been completed for you to play through and beat. It gets very tough up in the mountains, I hope you brought your best skills with you.
Enemy art has been updated to use graphics created by Ækashics ( http://www.akashics.moe/ ). This should help the game feel a little less dull in terms of how the enemies appear, for now.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/38c67851794d0fcff8036bc2a0311333d421b7f3.png

Battle Clear! Reward!
At the end of each battle you'd receive some text boxes to let you know how much AC you were rewarded in each fight. That's been changed to show it on the screen instead. Just click and it'll continue then go away when you're done checking out how much you made.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/7bd6415ca247cb39394b848d76d46cfa59e28d5a.png
In the future, all other notifications will be added to this end of battle screen.


Skill Changes
A few adjustments to skills have been made that are important to note. Various powerful skills have had their TP costs increased to match their power. In the future they will be scaled back to more reasonable levels with adjustments in their power. This isn't to say I'm nerfing the hell of them, just making not as powerful.
The other change is that skills that have secondary effects (such as Ralph's Rundown which heals you after dealing a successful to the enemy) will only have their secondary effect happen if the skill doesn't miss or isn't evaded.

More Achievements!
More achievements have been added. Have fun unlocking them all!

Patch Notes
Here's all the notes in their wordy glory, have a look!

ADDITIONS:
✪ A Rank added
✪ Molly's Art added
✪ Added more achievements
✪ New Enemy Art
✪ End of Battle GUI
CHANGES:
✪ Adjusted the TP cost of various skills
✪ Modified stat growth of Borrel and Drel
✪ Modifed AGI growth of Ralph
✪ Skills with secondary effects will not happen if the attack misses
✪ Full Heal now fully recovers entire party from the menu
✪ Damage formula has been modified to provide enemy's a chance against characters that have too high of defense
✪ Flying enemies are a little less weak to ranged weapons now
✪ Enemies with non-human intelligence resist Molly's Revolt and Derack's Parley
✪ Enemies with non-human greed resist Derack's Bribe
✪ Ralph's Whirlwind now has the ability to critical hit
✪ Venomous Bite now only has chance to poison
✪ Orbs have had their attributes adjusted for balance
✪ You no longer gain or lose consecutive level counters when transferring levels between characters
FIXES:
✪ Borrel's Intimidate lowers ATK, not DEF, as it should
✪ Petrify works again and counts down within 3 turns before you are petrified
✪ Drel will no longer steal Ralph's level up conversion levels
✪ Valeria won't get mad at you anymore for using the level conversion shop and then leveling up afterwards
✪ Daily bonus reward is now properly rewarded every 24 hours and won't reset every time you load the game
✪ Fixed some augments not properly removing their properties
✪ Derack's Saber weapon now has 2 Orb slots as it should
✪ Borrel's Claw weapon now have 1 Orb slot per weapon
✪ C Rank losses are properly tracked now
✪ C Rank wins will no longer go into the negatives
✪ Tutorial achievements can now be unlocked
✪ Enemy Sting (B) skill now has chance to poison
✪ Derack's Curing Tongue now heals as it should
✪ Derack's Roar now deals damage and debuffs the enemy as it should
✪ All B Rank rewards can properly be received now
✪ Ghost Ralph no longer reals
✪ Minor text fixes




What's Next?
Some of the changes I bring to Mythic Victory Arena take a while to create and updates aren't as frequent as like, or progress moving forward isn't where I quite want it. I'm always hard at work attempting to push the game forward into a state that is fun to play for you as the player. With each new addition and each change I bring about more issues, but more depth. I am reaching the milestones and goals I set for myself so the game can continue to grow. I'm happy that I am reaching the goals I make regardless of the time it takes.

So, anyway, here's what is next.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/ce0d728a18276a1c17ce2d56a9412aa02c4032be.gif

I'll be re-creating a lot of the skill action sequences from the ground up while adding new animations in the next update. After that, I'll move on to creating the S Rank and beyond.

As always, thanks for reading and for playing Mythic Victory Arena!

notes.title: July 4th Update - NEW GAME REQUIRED
notes.notes:
Greetings challengers and champions, new and returning! This new update brings forth a lot of amazing changes that really look out for your best interest as players.

Please Wait...
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/6824c044f99ec1ba307cb7853e42d057e87683fe.png

IMPORTANT - NEW GAME REQUIRED
Due to a few major changes to the game, it is required that you start a new game. This is not optional, you must start a new game or you will receive crash errors. This is caused by fixing the bestiary menu.

With that said, let's get to the notes.

Pre-loading
In the fight to prevent lag in initializing sounds and images throughout gameplay, a pre-load system has been put into place. Every time you start the game, you'll be greeting with the load menu you saw above. Give it a moment and then you'll be able to jump right into the arena.

New Hud
Are you ready for this one, player? You better be ready. With this update, Mythic Victory Arena now has hud elements to provide you with some basic character information before entering the arena as well as new information inside of the arena.

Take a look at the arena menu here:

Woah, champion, take a moment and visit the hospital before jumping into these notes, you'll need to be at full health to hear all this!

IMPORTANT - NEW GAME REQUIRED
I really hate having to do this two times in a row, but it's a necessary evil to make sure the game is as good as it can be and can continue to be.
The Bestiary wasn't properly working since the game was released in its Early Access state, but it works now, and it's the reason for you to start a new game.
It hurts to make you go through this, but this is early access and this is likely to happen. I'm glad it hasn't happened often though.

In the future, I'll do my best to avoid a forced new game.

B Rank Unlocked!
The B Rank has been completed and is now available for play in Mythic Victory Arena. Face off against the water-type enemies who have a number of special properties to them.
Some enemies gain a stat increase whenever they kill one of the challengers.
Some enemies have their stats shuffle around each turn.
Some enemies can take you with them if you kill them.
Some enemies stack up their defenses against you, making them harder to kill.
Have fun in the B Rank!

Bestiary Update!
The cause of your forced new game, the Bestiary now works, but still needs to undergo some changes before it's at its full potential. For now, here's a screenshot of what it currently looks like:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/9aff27285305cac2ffc230dbbf831ec5a7bae682.png

Level Up!
While playing through Mythic Victory Arena, you'll notice you level up when you get a chance to gain Gold, EXP, or a skill. After your first 10 level up rewards however, you only see that message every 5 levels. So, to inform the player that the character they are playing has leveled up, I've added a message to show whenever it happens.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/ebc7a2c1dc1703c993dca6c13028c56596d314bb.png

A new item has been added to the game, called the Full Heal. This item heals all party members to maximum HP and MP, removes paralysis and poison, and can only be used from the menu. It's an item meant for use once you've unlocked the hospital and no longer receive free heals after every fight.
Or... you can sell it for 1000AC.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/a637dae4a1762cb80ad7048316769746d2165a4e.png

Since Mythic Victory Arena released on Steam in Early Access, there has always been one constant, the Arena Rewards. After going through a week-long play test myself, I've realized the AC reward for each arena was just too little to play with and forced grinding to the point of boredom.
Each Rank has received a tweak to their rewards and the Rank Clear Bonus has been massively increased, making it easier for players to move into the next rank with minimal grinding.

Drops!
Enemy drop rates have been changed to include more possible drops. It's possible to now receive a sack full of items once you clear an arena fight, which you can promptly unload into the item shop if you don't need anything. Rank+ enemies have increase drop rates and have the chance to drop ultra rare items.

Warning!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/362b585b8a46668adec33d6a39315a9ecb757b0b.png

Primarily, axes, staves, and plate armors were touched, but a lot of special unlock reward items received balancing to prevent the game from becoming too easy. You can check which ones received changes in the patch notes below.

notes.notes:
Champions and challengers of the Mythic Victory Arena. Welcome back for another update with a load of content before pushing forwards into the next rank.
Let's get right into it and mark the important additions and as always, the patch notes are at the bottom of the page.

IMPORTANT - NEW GAME REQUIRED
Due to some updates of core plugins, you are required to start a new game or you WILL encounter errors while playing this new update.

It is recommended you delete your previous save files to ignore the temptation of playing on them, but before you do that, you should transfer your AC to the new save.

START A NEW GAME. IT IS REQUIRED.
START A NEW GAME. IT IS REQUIRED.
START A NEW GAME. IT IS REQUIRED.
START A NEW GAME. IT IS REQUIRED.
START A NEW GAME. IT IS REQUIRED.

Interface Tutorials
Navigating the menus in Mythic Victory Arena definitely seems daunting for first time players, especially when it comes to shopping. To that end, I've added interface tutorials for each shop area. The shopkeepers will talk you through using the menu if you say "Yes, please" to them.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/54fcea29281ea1c1833c44b9fa5552fcac61aac7.png

If you complete all the tutorials, you'll be rewarded with an achievement!

Status Change - Confusion and Paralysis
Confusion and Paralysis have received changes to how they function. They are as follows:
If you are confused, you no longer attack anyone, but instead have a 50% chance for your attack to fail. If it fails, you hit yourself. It lasts for 4 turns and can't be removed via damage.
If you are paralyzed, you now have a 35% chance to have any action you take to fail. It also no longer disappears after a set number of turns.

Target Selection Update
This is the reason you have to start a new game, but before you start grumbling at it, take a look at this screenshot:

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/7eaf6887fb922f3424a9fa7e689a628aa93d5e2d.png

With this update, most single target magic spells have the ability to target all enemies at once instead of targeting them one by one. This is a game changer. Also, you can target anyone with a single target skill.

Enemy HP Bars
Ever wondered why it feels like an enemy never dies? Aside from that aggravating game-breaking bug that gives an enemy undefined HP, you can now see the reason why, with an HP bar! An enemy's HP bar will only be revealed after you defeat an enemy of that type to begin with, though.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/2f2742eb7918c09354b0c2e868806fce5ae0a00e.png
 
Static Battle Menu Skills
All characters now have Static Battle Menu Skills. What's a Static Battle Menu Skill, you ask? It's a special skill that each character has that they have by default upon starting the game. You can use this skill in battle from the menu of attack options. You've likely seen them as Ralph's Frenzy, Leora's Panic, and Denira's Pray.
Here's what Drel's Static Battle Menu Skill looks like:

notes.title: May 27th Update
notes.notes:
Champions! I've been hard at work (both on this project and my two jobs irl) to prepare and push more polish out for you to enjoy before moving on to the next update, which will be attacking the problem of guiding new players through the layout of the Arena. For now, however, I've done a lot of work since the last update and you should read about it below.

New Addition! Pick Two
At the start of the game, you'd select your character and be off in the Arena without much to get you started, except for the gear on your back and the 750AC given to you by the current-standing Champion. This is no longer the case, after you start the game and select your character you'll be given the option to start the game with two skills. This is mandatory, you can not choose to have no skills (why would you though?) Here's a screenshot of it, so you know what to expect.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/8a46dceafa7b3a3c7edda08c94081f3b7a98d450.png

Clicking on a skill will tell you what it does and ask for your confirmation. This will make it easier on starting a new game from now on.

Skill Standardization
A lot of the default skills were created at a time of exploration, with very little proper thought and structure going into them. You would have noticed this in the higher rank of skills you saw. Some descriptions would be wrong and some would just not do what you'd expect them to do. Everything is standardized based on the skills you would receive in the level up unlock selections.
That means cooldowns, warmups, and status infliction percentages are all standard across the board now.

Skill Unlock Grants
Speaking of Level Up Unlocks, that has also been adjusted. When you level up and select to unlock a skill, any skill you choose will be immediately be given to you at its lowest rank, very useful if you're still holding onto that F Rank gear, but also useful so you won't be spending AC to learn that skill after unlocking it, which is really unintuitive to its design.

Formulae and Costs
With this update and the standardization mentioned before, all the skills throughout the game that haven't been properly standardized saw treatment given to them to fix up their costs and their battle formulas. Formulas for skills have been streamlined to fix a pesky bug that's an extremely silly corner case. None-the-less, that bug has been addressed. You'll see it in the patch notes. 
As for costs, skills now have higher costs for each character, due to how combat plays out and to encourage the use of various other support items and skills in battle before using the really good skills. The important ones are noted in the patch notes, but almost all skills received this treatment.

Extras
Aside from all the good stuff mentioned above, I wanted to quickly talk about a few changes and fixes I think need to be mentioned.
EXP is awarded based on successful hit and the damage you do is a factor in the EXP rewarded. Another factor is, but hasn't been that noticeable, is your rank in the Arena. It's been changed to be more noticeable. The higher your rank in the Arena, the less EXP you gain from grinding the lower rank fights. The punishment is a little less severe if you're attacking the Rank+ encounter enemies, but it's still there.
A unique identifier has been added to the game to prevent save scumming to give yourself infinite gold with the AC Transfer system.
For some reason, the game would disallow you into a rank or clicking the C Rank would place you inside of the D Rank. This has been noticed and fixed twice now. Either the game hates me, or someone is pranking me. I hope this issue doesn't pop up again.

That's all for now, below you can find the patch notes in all of their wordy glory:

✪ Select 2 skills at start of game
CHANGES:
✪ AC Transfer can't be exploited
✪ Decreased total EXP gain to grinding a lower rank arena
✪ Level up unlock skills are now granted to the player upon unlock
✪ Status infliction chances for many skills have been standardized 
✪ Cooldowns and Warmups for many skills have been standardized 
✪ Less text if Story Mode option is Off
✪ Denira's healing skills can now have a chance to critical hit (Crit heals!)
✪ Combat magic skills can now have a chance to critical hit (Crit magic!)
✪ Learn cost of Denira's Evade Magic has been lowered
✪ Denira's Prayer skill now has a chance to inflict Smiting Sickness
✪ Shield Spin (Ralph/Derack) now 100% causes confusion to a single target
✪ Critical value variance for many skills has been adjusted
✪ Formula for the following skills have been adjusted:
      ✪ Damage of Ralph's Shine Smash
      ✪ Damage of Leora's Power Shot
      ✪ Damage of Leora's Barrage
      ✪ Damage of many of Derack's skills
      ✪ Healing Power of Denira's skills
      ✪ Damage of many elemental magic skills
✪ Casting costs for the following skills have been changed:
      ✪ MP Cost for Drel's Flicker has been increased
      ✪ MP + HP Cost for Drel's Force of Will has been increased
      ✪ MP Costs for Denira's healing and holy skills have been increased
      ✪ MP + TP Costs for Denira's elemental based skills have been adjusted
      ✪ MP Costs for combat magic (Drel/Molly) skills have been increased
      ✪ TP Costs for Leora's elemental based skills have been adjusted
      ✪ TP Costs for Derack's elemental based skills have been adjusted
      ✪ TP Costs for Ralph's default skills have been increased
FIXES:
✪ Right Click Leave option now functions as intended
✪ All current ranks are now properly accessible
✪ A first time use of a skill in a rank you have 0 wins in would deal 0 damage. That is no longer the case for all skills
✪ Borrel's Dropkick can now properly be learned
✪ Drel's Force of Will skill line can properly be learned
✪ Derack can properly learn Slice n' Dice now
✪ Learn Cost for Shield Spin and Shield Bash requires the proper armors now
✪ Ice (C) can now properly be learned
✪ All of Leora's skills now can critical hit
✪ All of Derack's skills now can critical hit
✪ Icon for Leora's Wind Shot has the proper icon
✪ Minor text fixes

Thanks for keeping up with Mythic Victory Arena!

notes.title: October 14th Update
notes.notes:
Hello new and returning champions!


Today a substantial update is being pushed out that resolves a lot of issues, as well as changes some features that were not given enough care. You may scroll to the bottom of the page for the patch notes.

Let's begin with the biggest change -- Augments.

Augments
Augments were heavily underappreciated and neglected during initial design and in release on Steam. This is no longer the case. Orbs and Glyphs are now extremely detailed and provide a multitude of benefits for your champions to utilize on their weapons and armors. 
Weapons may now only have up to two orbs on them at any time, except for the F Rank Weapons, which may only have up to one.
Armors may now only have up to one glyph on them at any time.

Here is what you can expect when selecting a rank from the Augments Shop:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/368bdbc2968cdd872efed30dfdf5deb394399161.png

And here is a nice view of some orbs that you'll be able to play with in the game:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/fed60e0610471aac998c8a870d9bfb2e294a5c44.png

Pro Mode
Pro Mode is a new option that has been added to the options menu which you can access from either the Main Menu or the Champion Menu. With Pro Mode enabled, you will not be prompted to any beginner prompts or any other prompt which is set to warn players of challenging aspects they may or may not be ready for.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/3465bd63946fea24c7ac11e10247d48bee664783.png

Enemies
The arena has received the care it needed. All enemies now function properly and have attack animations which were badly needed. 
On to the battles aspect, When you complete a rank you will be allowed access to fight in the Rank+ battles, where you face off against the same enemies from the corresponding rank, except they are twice as strong and drop better items.

Here is what that looks like:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/d865af0b1447787c0824f0c448e7ff8b98a93707.png

If you don't have Pro Mode enabled, each time you select to fight in a Rank+ battle you will receive this prompt:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952551/02730b6f9b2598d89d1d688ddb8b57fa48d1a57d.png


Misc. Fixes and Changes
Aside from these three new things being the biggest and impactful changes to the game going forward, there are a few notable fixes and changes that you may find to be good news.
By default on a complete fresh start of the game (or if you delete your config.rpgsave from the saves folder), BGM Volume is defaulted to 10%.
Volume control settings are now by increments of 10 instead of 20.
More prompts for beginners have been added to inform them of features which they will want to take use of. The notable example being Hires.
Denira has access to her Holy spells so long as she has a weapon equipped. If you are using a save from before this update, you will have to purchase a new weapon for Denira.
The rest of the patch notes can be viewed below.

Patch Notes
ADDED:
✪ Attack animations for enemies
✪ Rank+ battles after a rank is cleared. These battles are twice as hard.
✪ More beginner prompts to let players know of things they shouldn't miss out on
✪ Pro Mode option to ignore beginner prompts and warning prompts
✪ Information about possible lag whilst playing the game
✪ Modifier that lessens the amount of EXP you gain by a percentage from enemies of lower ranks

CHANGED:
✪ Orbs have been revamped
✪ Weapons may only have up to two Orbs on them now (F Rank unaffected)
✪ Armors may only have up to one Glyph on them now
✪ Lowered Ralph's base DEF
✪ Ralph's base Crit Rate is now 1%
✪ Increased Denira's base ATK (again?)
✪ Lowered ATK values of all axes
✪ Removed Gold Window from Character Select Screen
✪ Gold Window disables while talking to other characters
✪ Disabled typesound in messages
✪ Lessened amount of events in an attempt to reduce Battle Results Lag
✪ Volume for all sounds is now 10 by default. You may delete config.rpgsave from your saves folder to restore the default options
✪ Options Volume offset is now 10 instead of 20.
✪ Chain Attack now hits twice before checking if it hits more times
✪ Unlocked Skills that provide battle effects are now known as Static and can be used with any weapon equipped

FIXED:
✪ Bats now have a chance to drop Bat Guano
✪ Shiny Power now has information as to what it does
✪ Coldspot and Hotspot damage formulas are now affected by your Rank Wins
✪ Second Wind is no longer permanent
✪ Shine Blast now works properly
✪ Denira now has access to her Holy spells (Heal, Revive, etc)
✪ All Champions now have proper access to Chain Whip Skills
✪ Imps no longer Boast for no reason.
✪ Mage Robes are now Bodygear instead of Accessory
✪ Revive skill Learn no longer costs an annoying amount of Angel's Kisses
✪ You will now be properly informed when you can receive a reward from The Champion
✪ MP Regen state now properly returns 10% of maxMP

OTHER:
✪ Minor text fixes
